title: Message templates
subtitle: Write each message once per language. Every language version is approved by WhatsApp separately.
empty.title: No templates yet
empty.body: Start from the ready-made library: every message comes in English and Arabic, ready to adjust.
archive.confirmMessage: "{name}" will be hidden from your lists. Nothing is deleted, and you can restore it at any time.
unarchive.confirmMessage: "{name}" will appear in your lists again.
usage.title: WhatsApp template space
usage.summary: {used} of {limit} WhatsApp template slots used. New submissions pause at {ceiling}.
usage.unknown: We couldn't check how many WhatsApp template slots are used right now.
usage.explain: Every language version, and every edited version, uses one slot. Slots can't be reclaimed, so edit approved templates only when you really need to.
usage.atCeiling: WhatsApp template space is nearly full, so submitting for approval is paused. Contact WaFlow.
new.title: New template
new.name: Template name
new.nameRequired: Enter a name for the template.
category.hintMarketing: Promotions and offers. Only sent to customers who opted in, and it needs an opt-out button.
category.hintUtility: Order, payment and booking updates. WhatsApp may still classify it as Marketing.
category.alwaysMarketing: Marketing and promotional messages are always sent as Marketing, which means only to customers who opted in.
library.title: Template library
library.intro: Ready-made messages in English and Arabic. Pick one, then adjust it to sound like your business.
library.note: Draft: the Arabic wording needs a native reader's review before customers receive it.
library.fieldsNote: Fields such as {name} are filled in for each customer when you send.
library.pick: Pick a message to see it in both languages.
editor.name: Template name
editor.categoryWarning: Changing the category affects WhatsApp approval and pricing.
editor.categoryConfirmMessage: Changing the category to {category} affects how WhatsApp approves and prices this template. Versions already approved keep their current approval until you submit them again.
editor.archivedBanner: This template is archived. Restore it to use it again.
editor.flowLinked: This template belongs to an automated flow message. Its flow buttons are managed by the flow.
missing.body: Each language version has its own text, buttons and WhatsApp approval.
add.combine: Combine the Arabic and English versions
add.translateTitle: Or let AI draft it for you
add.translateNeedsText: Add the other version first to translate from it.
field.headerHint: Optional short title. At most one merge field.
field.bodyHint: The main text. Add a few words before and after any merge field.
field.footerHint: Optional small line under the message. No merge fields.
mergeFields.title: Merge fields
mergeFields.hint: Select a field to insert it where your cursor is. Fields marked Auto are filled in for each customer. For the others you enter a value when you send a campaign.
field.name: Customer first name
buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.hint: Up to 3 buttons show directly under the message. Labels can be at most 20 characters.
buttons.needOptOut: Marketing messages need an opt-out button so customers can stop receiving them.
buttons.max: You can add up to {max} buttons.
buttons.flowLocked: This button comes from an automated flow and can't be changed here.
button.label: Button label
order.label: Language order
order.hint: Which language comes first in the combined message.
validation.title: Checks
validation.failed: We couldn't run the checks right now.
issue.unknown: Something in this version needs attention.
issue.meta_positional_syntax: Use named fields such as {name}, not numbered ones such as {{1}}.
issue.unbalanced_braces: A merge field has a missing or extra curly bracket.
issue.body_too_long: The message is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.header_too_long: The header is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.header_has_newline: The header must be a single line.
issue.header_too_many_variables: The header can have at most one merge field.
issue.footer_too_long: The footer is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.footer_has_variable: The footer can't contain merge fields.
issue.buttons_collapsed: Only the first {visible} buttons show directly. The rest sit behind a "See all options" button.
issue.button_label_too_long: A button label is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.duplicate_button_label: Two buttons have the same label.
issue.invalid_button_role: A button has a type that isn't allowed.
issue.buttons_wrong_order: Put the link buttons after the reply buttons.
issue.button_url_required: A link button needs a link.
issue.button_url_too_long: A button link is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.button_url_not_https: Button links must start with https://.
issue.button_url_has_field: Button links can't contain merge fields.
issue.button_url_invalid: A button link isn't a valid web address.
issue.too_many_url_buttons: Too many link buttons: {count} (the maximum is {max}).
issue.button_wrong_language: A button label doesn't match the language of this version.
issue.flow_button_mismatch: The flow buttons don't match the linked flow message.
issue.flow_button_without_message_node: A flow button needs a linked flow message.
issue.marketing_requires_opt_out_button: Marketing messages need an opt-out button.
issue.body_starts_with_variable: The message can't start with a merge field. WhatsApp rejects it.
issue.body_ends_with_variable: The message can't end with a merge field. WhatsApp rejects it.
issue.adjacent_variables: Two merge fields sit next to each other. Put a word between them.
issue.too_many_variables_for_length: There are too many merge fields for such a short message ({variables} fields in {length} characters).
issue.repeated_field: The same merge field appears more than once.
issue.arabic_variant_has_no_arabic: This is the Arabic version but the message has no Arabic text. WhatsApp will reject it.
issue.english_variant_is_mostly_arabic: This is the English version but most of the text is Arabic.
issue.arabic_indic_digits_in_body: The message uses Arabic-Indic digits. Use Western digits (0-9) instead.
issue.bilingual_needs_both_languages: A bilingual message should contain both Arabic and English text.
issue.bilingual_order_mismatch: The text doesn't start with the language you chose to show first.
issueHint.body_starts_with_variable: Add a few words before the field, for example a greeting.
issueHint.body_ends_with_variable: Add a few words after the field, for example a closing sentence.
unsavedConfirmMessage: You have unsaved changes. If you continue, they will be lost.
resetsApproval: Saving a change puts this version back to Not created and Draft. It then needs to be submitted and reviewed again.
aiSourceNote: This text started as an AI draft. A native reader should check it.
preview.title: Preview
preview.sample: Sample values are used for merge fields.
preview.bilingualHint: A bilingual message arrives as one message with both languages.
approval.title: WhatsApp approval
approval.empty: Add this version to manage its approval.
categoryChanged: WhatsApp classified this version as Marketing, so it will only be sent to customers who opted in.
categoryChangedOther: WhatsApp classified this version as {category}, not the category you chose.
statusHelp.PENDING: WhatsApp is reviewing it. This usually takes minutes but can take up to 24 hours.
statusHelp.REJECTED: WhatsApp rejected it. Change the text and submit it again.
statusHelp.PAUSED: WhatsApp paused this version because of low quality. It can't be sent for now.
statusHelp.DISABLED: WhatsApp disabled this version. It can't be sent.
statusHelp.IN_APPEAL: An appeal is being reviewed by WhatsApp.
statusHelp.PENDING_DELETION: This version is being removed on WhatsApp.
statusHelp.DELETED: This version was removed on WhatsApp.
statusHelp.ARCHIVED: This version is archived on WhatsApp.
statusHelp.ERROR: The last submission failed. Check the error below and try again.
submit.confirmMessage: This sends the {language} version to WhatsApp (Meta) for approval. While it is pending you can't change the text without creating a new version, and every version uses one of your WhatsApp template slots permanently.
submit.reason.invalid: Fix the problems listed in the checks first.
submit.reason.pending: Already submitted and waiting for WhatsApp.
submit.reason.approved: Already approved. Edit and save the text to submit a new version.
submit.reason.ceiling: Submissions are paused because WhatsApp template space is nearly full.
dryRunNotice: Test mode: nothing was sent to WhatsApp.
test.title: Send a test message to my phone
test.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +966.
test.confirmMessage: A real WhatsApp message will be sent to {phone}. Use your own number.
test.onlyApproved: You can send a test once WhatsApp has approved this version.
review.title: Native review
review.arabicRule: A native Arabic reader must confirm this wording before customers receive it. Arabic and bilingual versions can't be sent in campaigns until they are marked Reviewed.
review.englishOptional: Review is optional for English versions.
review.confirmReviewedMessage: You confirm that a native reader has checked the wording of the {language} version and it is fine to send to customers.
review.confirmDraftTitle: Move this version back to draft?
review.confirmDraftMessage: It can't be sent to customers until it is reviewed again.
sendable.title: Can this be sent?
sendable.ok: Yes. This version is approved and ready to send.
sendable.not_submitted: Not yet: it hasn't been submitted to WhatsApp.
sendable.pending: Not yet: WhatsApp is still reviewing it.
sendable.flagged: Not recommended: WhatsApp flagged this version as at risk.
sendable.not_approved: Not yet: it isn't approved by WhatsApp.
sendable.not_reviewed: Not yet: it is waiting for native review.
sendable.missing: No: this version doesn't exist yet.
sendable.unknown: Not yet: this version isn't ready.
submit.reason.status: This version can't be submitted in its current WhatsApp status.
